evidence.observation: The first viewport names Jamie, the target role, the value proposition, and direct paths to selected work, resume, and contact.
The page keeps Jamie's attributed planning role distinct from Board and Council actions and states that appropriation is not disbursement, receipt, expenditure, or completion.
Claim-level references identify what event, press, repository, and graphic sources support, expose source-specific limits, and provide accessible backlinks.
The long chronology, repeated collective-work boundaries, Sources and notes section, and Known / Open / Protected material are useful but require more reading than the primary application path.
Jamie is visible as the actor and the proof map names concrete work and outcomes, though phrases such as source-backed memory and public-data framing still require some domain familiarity.
The Artifact gallery presents text cards for the prototype, translation layer, and press note rather than an approved image of the actual interface.
The HTML role, chronology, selected impact, and corrected CallNYC framing agree with the approved downloadable resume PDF.

Candidate-bound evidence reports no desktop, mobile, or 200%-equivalent overflow and visible focus for all 24 traversed controls, including nine citation markers; browser-chrome zoom itself was not exercised.
The route supplies a canonical URL, specific Open Graph title, generated social image, summary-large-image card, working resume download, and contact path; inspected metadata remains staging-bound.

The candidate has documented staging configuration, health and robots checks, candidate-bound local route evidence, and rollback guidance; deployed-commit verification and production monitoring remain correctly deferred.
